description: Start a US trademark application on Arcangel AI as a draft in the signed-in user's account. Pass what is known (the mark, goods or services, classes, owner); the rest can be added later with update_trademark_application. If a company owns the mark, pass the id of a saved company (list_companies) as company_id. Returns the draft id and what it still needs. Requires Sign in with Arcangel. Signing and payment happen on arcangel.ai.

acronym_meaning.description: What the letters stand for, if the mark is an acronym.

additional_statements.description: Any other statement for the application.

attorney_signs.description: Whether the reviewing attorney should sign the application directly.

company_id.description: Id of a saved company (list_companies) that owns the mark. Fills the company name, state of registration and address from the saved profile, so do not also send those. null unlinks it.

company_jurisdiction.description: State or country where the company is organized, e.g. Delaware.

company_name.description: Company legal name, when a company owns the mark.

disclaimer.description: Words in the mark the owner does not claim on their own, e.g. a generic term like "Coffee".

filing_basis.description: use_in_commerce_1a: already selling under the mark. intent_to_use_1b: planning to.

first_use_date.description: Date the mark was first used anywhere (YYYY-MM-DD).

first_use_in_commerce_date.description: Date the mark was first used in US interstate commerce (YYYY-MM-DD).

goods_services.description: The goods or services the mark is used for, in plain words.

mark.description: The mark to apply for, e.g. "Lumora".

mark_description.description: For design or composite marks: describe the design elements.

mark_type.description: word: text only. design: a logo with no words. composite: a logo that includes words.

non_latin_characters.description: Whether the mark contains non-Latin characters (e.g. Chinese or Arabic script).

owner_citizenship.description: Citizenship of an individual owner, e.g. United States.

owner_entity_type.description: Who owns the mark. Use company for an LLC, corporation or partnership, and set legal_entity.

owner_name.description: Legal name of the person or company that will own the mark.

portrait_signature.description: Whether the mark shows a living person's name, portrait or signature, and their consent.

prior_registrations.description: The owner's prior US registrations for this mark, if any.

signatory_name.description: Name of the person who will sign for the owner.

signatory_title.description: Signatory's title, e.g. CEO or Owner.

translation.description: English translation of any non-English words in the mark.

translation_language.description: Language of the non-English words, e.g. Spanish.

transliteration.description: Transliteration of any non-Latin characters in the mark.

name: start_trademark_application
title: Start a trademark application
